name: Lörrach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, yellow and red, charged above the centre with the city arms of Lörrach (a yellow lark on red).
history: By decision of the Ministry of the Interior of Baden-Württemberg of 11 November 1975 the city may fly a flag in the colours red and yellow, re-granted after the incorporation of Hauingen and Brombach on 1 January 1975.

features.role: Lörrach arms — yellow lark on red
